call_purpose: You wanted your webinar registration page to send the confirmation email and your products page to show the right currency.

resolved.text: We turned on the confirmation email for your webinar page and saved it.
You registered once with another email address as a test, and the confirmation email arrived.
Following our guidance, you selected Indian Rupee in Settings, then Regional, and saved it; your products page now shows rupees.

covered.text: We explained that the currency is set in your account's regional settings, which only the account owner can change.
